title: Autism Spectrum Disorder (Documented)
description: Public documented information: Autism Spectrum Disorder is classified in DSM-5-TR among neurodevelopmental disorders, documented around persistent differences in social communication/interaction and restricted, repetitive patterns per documented criteria — summarized generally. ICD-11 classifies autism spectrum disorder similarly. Documented note: many autistic people and advocates prefer identity-first language ("autistic person") — this database follows the community’s lead. Autism is a developmental difference, not a disease; support needs vary widely; dignity is unconditional.

symptoms: Documented criteria as above — summarized generally; professional assessment required; community language preferences honored.
